Specification: This specification models the Two-Phase Commit (2PC) protocol for distributed transactions, focusing on the behavior of resource managers (RMs) as they transition through various states: working, prepared, committed, and aborted. The model defines the possible actions each RM can take (Prepare and Decide), and specifies the protocol's next-state relation as the disjunction of these actions for all RMs. The specification asserts type correctness and consistency invariants, ensuring that no two RMs can reach conflicting decisions (i.e., one committed and one aborted), and verifies these invariants as properties of the protocol. The model does not explicitly include faults or failures beyond the abort/commit logic, and does not model a coordinator or message passing.
